newsitem.title: ITALY: Two crew injured in tanker blast off Sardinia.
newsitem.headline: Two crew injured in tanker blast off Sardinia.

text.p: An explosion started a fire on board an oil tanker off the coast of Sardinia on Monday, injuring two crewmen, port officials said on Tuesday.
The Cypriot-flagged Maria E was empty at the time of the blast. It was thought to have been caused by residual fumes.

They said two Filipino crewmen, one of whom was blown off the ship, were seriously injured. The fire was extinguished by the crew and firefighters. The 3,794-tonne ship was anchored in the Gulf of Cagliari waiting to take on oil at a refinery.
